ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of each direct shareholder, indirect UBO, legal representative and proposed director against: (i) the UIAF Colombian consolidated terrorist and money-laundering risk lists, (ii) the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, (iii) the U.S. OFAC SDN List, (iv) the European Union consolidated sanctions list, and (v) Colombian PEP registries (congressional, gubernatorial, mayoral, Comptroller, and Attorney General databases), all conducted under SAGRILAFT requirements with documented risk rating, enhanced due diligence for PEPs, continuous monitoring obligations, and a 10-year record-retention duty.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) – www.rues.org.co, administered by the 57 Cámaras de Comercio (including Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá and the competent local chamber)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be expressed in Spanish or in a language using the Latin alphabet; the S.A.S. name must include the expression 'S.A.S.' or 'Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada'; no transliteration is required, but the name must be distinctive, not confusingly similar to an existing registered name, and not contrary to public policy or good customs.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banco, Bancario, Financiera (prior authorization of the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia)
Seguros, Aseguradora, Reaseguradora (prior authorization of the Superintendencia Financiera)
Fondo de Pensiones, Cesantías, Fiduciaria (prior financial-sector regulator authorization)
Cooperativa, Mutual (prior authorization of the Superintendencia de la Economía Solidaria)
Bolsa de Valores, Derivados (prior authorization of the financial market regulator)
Salud, Médico, Clínica, Hospital, IPS (prior Ministry of Health and Social Protection / INVIMA approval for regulated health activities)
Droguería, Farmacéutica, Dispositivo Médico (prior INVIMA authorization concerning medical-device manufacturing and sale)
Petróleo, Minera, Hidrocarburos (prior authorization of the Ministry of Mines and Energy)

Sociedad, Compañía, Empresa, Corporación (restricted corporate-form tokens governed by Chamber registry doctrine)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the homonymy clearance is rejected, the applicant receives an automatic notification in the RUES online system; the rejection may be contested by filing a 'recurso de reposición' (reconsideration) before the relevant Cámara de Comercio within 10 business days, and, subsidiarily, a 'recurso de apelación' to the Superintendencia de Sociedades, pursuant to Ley 1437 de 2011. Concurrently, the applicant may submit a revised name variant with an alternate distinctive phrase or a numerical element; the reserved-name certificate is renewable once within the 30-day window before lapse.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or counsel's address is accepted for the S.A.S. domicilio social provided legal notices can be effectively served at that physical Colombian address; however, the ISIC 3250 dialysis-hemofilter manufacturing activity requires a physical Colombian establishment (establecimiento fabricador) registered before the Cámara de Comercio and licensed by INVIMA, so a purely virtual structure is impermissible for production operations.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High: approximately 85–90% probability of a pre-approval INVIMA GMP/BPM inspection prior to the award of the medical-device sanitary registration; approximately 35% annual probability of unannounced periodic INVIMA surveillance inspections after registration; and a 10–15% probability of a Chamber of Commerce verification visit within the first operational year.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Código de Comercio Arts. 98–131 (mercantile registry) y 353–372, Decreto 1074 de 2015 (RUES) y Resolución 100-000058 de 2022 de la Supersociedades
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá / Registro Único Empresarial (RUES)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución inscrito en el Registro Mercantil
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital for S.A.S. under Ley 1258/2008; the incorporators fix the capital freely in the bylaws. For the manufacturing scope, a declared paid-in capital of COP 50,000,000 is recommended to support industrial licensing. The capital must be fully paid up and deposited in a Colombian financial institution; a certificate of deposit or escrow receipt must be produced at the time of registry filing.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the paid-in share capital be subscribed and fully paid by the founding shareholders in accordance with Article 6 of the Bylaws, and that the corporate escrow bank account be designated as the depository for capital contributions. RESOLVED, that the registered office be established at Calle 100 No. 13-21, Office 402, Bogotá D.C., Colombia, and that the legal representative be authorized to execute all filings with the Chamber of Commerce. RESOLVED, that the following officers be appointed: General Manager, Legal Representative, and Compliance Officer, with duties defined by the Bylaws and Colombian corporate law. RESOLVED, that the Company proceed with registration before DIAN and initiate all industrial and environmental license applications required for the manufacture of dialysis filters.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Corporate Governance Review
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá – RUES online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the RUES web portal, complete the company name pre-reservation request using the denomimation 'CO_SAS Disposable Dialysis Hemofilter SAS', verify the absence of identical or confusingly similar registered names, and reserve the exclusive corporate name for a maximum non-extendable term of 30 calendar days.
required_dossiers: Valid identification document of each incorporator
Draft of the proposed S.A.S. bylaws
RUES name reservation application form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected due to similarity or prior reservation, file a new name reservation request or submit a written request for comparative name analysis to the Cámara de Comercio; a formal objection may be raised before the Superintendencia de Sociedades within 10 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarial Legalization of the Incorporation Instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Sign the Documento Privado de Constitución before a notary, with signatures legally authenticated (autenticación notarial). The notary will legalize the private document, verify the identity and capacity of the parties, and certify that the bye-laws conform to the mandatory S.A.S. provisions of Ley 1258 de 2008.
required_dossiers: Bylaws drafted in Spanish
Shareholders' subscription and payment declaration
Capital deposit certificate or bank escrow receipt
Valid passports or national ID cards of all shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary returns the document for corrections, prepare a notarial correction act (acta de corrección) and re-submit the same day; if the objection concerns legal admissibility, obtain a supplemental legal opinion from a local corporate attorney.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registry Filing and Mercantile Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá – Registro Mercantil (window or online RUES)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized private incorporation document together with the RUES pre-registration form, pay the official registration fee, and obtain the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal. The registry officer will carry out the formal legal review after incorporation and will assign the chamber registration number and the individual taxpayer enrollment datum (NIT).
required_dossiers: Notarized Documento Privado de Constitución
RUES full registration form with legal representative data
Receipt of payment of the registration fee
Certificate of deposit or capital payment receipt
Valid IDs of the legal representative and shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry files a query on formal defects, correct the deficiencies within 10 business days by filing a supplementary document. If the registry refuses registration, file an appeal for reconsideration before the President of the Cámara de Comercio or a complaint to the Superintendencia de Sociedades under Código de Comercio Art. 55.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – electronic portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving the mercantile registration certificate, enroll the company in the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) through DIAN's online transaccional system. Select the standard general tax regime, enter the principal economic activity code corresponding to ISIC 3250/NAICS 339112, and obtain the NIT. Also register for VAT, income tax and applicable municipal industry and commerce tax (ICA).
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Bylaws and incorporation document
Identity documents of the legal representative
Proof of address of the registered office
Bank certificate of capital deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects or queries the application, submit a correction request via the DIAN electronic 'Solución de Controversias' channel or appear at the DIAN local office to align the taxpayer classification; unresolved discrepancies can be addressed through the specialized tax assistance that resolves registration errors.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Bank Account Opening and Capital Contribution Deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank (e.g. Bancolombia, Davivienda) – corporate banking department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate checking account under the exact corporate name, deposit the full subscribed paid-in capital, and obtain a bank certificate of deposit (certificado de consignación) indicating the company name, amount, and reference to the incorporation account. This certificate is required for the registry filing and for subsequent industrial licensing.
required_dossiers: NIT certificate and RUT
Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Bylaws and board resolution on bank account opening
Passport or national ID of signatories
Bank-issued KYC application and AML questionnaire
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank issues a KYC objection due to incomplete documentation, provide enhanced due diligence documents (source of funds declaration, corporate chain disclosure, and references from the incorporators). Rejected applications can be filed with a second regulated bank; additional clarification is presented through the bank's compliance unit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Industrial Sanitary and Physical Establishment License Applications
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INVIMA (Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos) and ANLA (Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales) – cooperating windows
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the sanitary operating license (Registro Sanitario de Establecimiento Fabricante de Dispositivos Médicos) to INVIMA accompanied by a BPM (Good Manufacturing Practices) compliance protocol for medical device manufacturing. Simultaneously file the environmental impact screening with ANLA or the regional environmental authority (CAR) to demonstrate mandatory compliance with Decree 1076/2015. Obtain the fire safety certificate from the local fire department and the municipal occupancy approval from the Curaduría Urbana before commencing physical operations.
required_dossiers: Bylaws, NIT, RUT, and mercantile registration certificate
Manufacturing process description for hollow fiber polyethersulfone dialyzers
Environmental impact screening form and waste management plan
Fire safety certificate and civil defense clearance
Floor plan and structural load inspection report
Pollution control and effluent treatment compliance plan
INVIMA application form and fee payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If INVIMA or ANLA files a query (requerimiento), a subsanación response must be submitted within 15 business days providing the requested technical or environmental data. If the license is refused, appeal to the respective administrative body, or request a reconsideration meeting; if all remedies fail, initiate a contentious-administrative action before the Consejo de Estado.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos (INVIMA) – Dirección de Dispositivos Médicos
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro Sanitario de Establecimiento Fabricante de Dispositivos Médicos y Certificado de Buenas Prácticas de Manufactura (BPM)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) / autoridad ambiental regional competente (Corporación Autónoma Regional CAR)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Categoría II – Estudio de Impacto Ambiental Simplificado (no full EIA required for production capacities below 10,000 units/month of dialysis filters). If the manufacturing line includes solvent-based extrusion processes exceeding approved emission thresholds, escalate to Categoría I requiring a full EIA.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Decreto 1076 de 2015 (environmental management), Resolución 0631 de 2015 (maximum permissible discharge limits to surface waters: pH 6–9, DQO < 200 mg/L, SST < 80 mg/L, lead < 0.5 mg/L), and Resolución 2254 de 2017 (air quality). For volatile organic compounds (VOCs) generated in the extrusion and potting process, limit at 50 mg C/m³ per emission source under clean production protocols.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification issued by the local Cuerpo de Bomberos; structural load and occupancy inspection approved by the Curaduría Urbana; workplace occupational health clearance (ARL / Riesgos Laborales) for operation of extrusion machines, potting lines and sterile packaging equipment, complemented by an occupational hazard prevention plan and emergency response protocol.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – National Tax and Customs Authority; official portal: https://www.dian.gov.co; transactional services through MUISCA (Modelo Único de Ingresos, Servicio y Control Automatizado) at https://muisca.dian.gov.co.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Colombian SAS obtains its NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) and RUT (Registro Único Tributario) after incorporation before the Cámara de Comercio. The foreign shareholder must appoint a local legal representative or attorney-in-fact, provide apostilled and certified-translated corporate existence documents, and file the RUT registration through DIAN’s online MUISCA platform. The RUT is the sole tax identification card and must be updated within statutory timelines for any changes in address, legal representative, or taxable activities.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia does not provide federal check-the-box entity classification elections. A Colombian SAS is by default a resident tax entity subject to entity-level taxation. Available statutory elections include: (i) the business-group tax consolidation regime (Régimen de Grupo Empresarial) for economic groups holding at least 75% control, subject to prior DIAN authorization; and (ii) the simplified taxation regime (Régimen Simple de Tributación) for eligible taxpayers with gross ordinary income not exceeding the statutory threshold, replacing income tax and VAT obligations under specified conditions. Hybrid-mismatch elections are not available under local law; Colombia applies statutory nexus and controlled-foreign-company rules instead.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Impuesto sobre las Ventas – IVA) – national consumption tax administered by DIAN; separate local indirect taxes such as ICA (Industria y Comercio) may apply at the municipal level but are outside the national VAT regime.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general de minimis VAT registration threshold. A Colombian SAS engaged in any taxable supply of goods or services must register as a VAT-responsible person (responsable de IVA) before commencing operations and maintain a valid RUT. An optional simplified regime (Régimen Simple de Tributación) is available to eligible taxpayers whose gross ordinary income does not exceed 80,000 UVT (approximately COP 3.8 billion for tax year 2024, adjusted annually by DIAN resolution).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (Factura Electrónica de Venta – FEVM) applies to every VAT-registered SAS. Invoices must be transmitted to DIAN’s electronic invoicing platform via DIAN-validated software, DIAN web services/API, or authorized electronic-billing operators. Each invoice must contain a unique CUFE code and QR representation, be signed with the taxpayer’s digital certificate, and be reported to DIAN in near-real time. Electronic dispatch documents are also required for domestic goods movement, and electronic payroll documentation is mandatory where applicable. Non-compliant invoices do not confer VAT credit or expense deductibility.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods are excluded from Colombian VAT with entitlement to input-VAT credit and refunds when the exporter is a VAT-responsible entity, the goods physically leave the Colombian customs territory under a valid export declaration, the buyer is not domiciled in Colombia, and payment is received through authorized foreign-exchange channels in foreign currency. For services, the exclusion also requires that the service be used exclusively abroad and meet the DIAN’s offshore-services conditions. The exporter must maintain contemporaneous documentation evidencing the actual export, payment, and repatriation.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación) accepted through DIAN/MUISCA customs platform
Bill of Lading (B/L) or Airwaybill (AWB) / transport document
Commercial invoice expressly evidencing the export sale
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank certificate of foreign-currency deposit proving repatriation within the mandated term
Electronic export VAT invoice (FEVM) containing the valid CUFE
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN conducts targeted audits of export zero-rating and input-VAT refund claims by cross-referencing customs declarations, foreign-exchange receipts, and bank records. Failure to satisfy documentary or substantive requirements causes reversal of the VAT exclusion, disallowance of input credits, and retroactive clawbacks of refunds, together with late-payment interest from the date of undue benefit. Inaccuracy penalties under Article 647 ET may be imposed (generally up to 100% of the overstated refund or benefit), and intentional false export claims are subject to criminal customs and anti-evasion sanctions, including fines and imprisonment under applicable Colombian law.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Central Bank of Colombia) is the monetary and foreign-exchange authority; FX policy is issued by the Comité de Cambios and administered through Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83, while the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) supervises the authorized foreign exchange intermediaries (Intermediarios del Mercado Cambiario, IMCs) and enforces exchange-control sanctions jointly with the DIAN.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso (COP) is freely convertible for current-account operations (trade in goods and services, dividends, royalties, interest, personal remittances) provided the transaction is settled through an IMC and documented in the applicable Declaración de Cambio. Capital-account transactions — foreign direct investment (FDI), external credit, and portfolio investment — are also convertible but require registration of the capital entry with Banco de la República so that future dividends and capital repatriation can leave the country without additional licenses or quotas. There are no exchange-rate bands, buy-back quotas, or prior exchange licenses; in practice, profit remittance by a Colombian SAS is hindered only when (i) the inbound FDI was not registered with the central bank, (ii) the ultimate beneficial ownership (UBO) record is incomplete under DIAN rules, or (iii) the remittance is structured as a loan repayment exceeding the registered external credit. For a Colombian SAS manufacturing dialysis consumables, dividend remittances to a non-resident shareholder are lawful after the general shareholders meeting approves the distribution, subject to the applicable dividend withholding tax and bank-level source-of-funds documentation; no DIAN or central bank authorization is required for the remittance itself.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Colombian foreign exchange regime (Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83, as amended), 100% of the export proceeds from Colombian goods must be channeled through an IMC. For goods such as dialysis hemofilters, the exporter must lodge the proceeds and sell the foreign currency into the Colombian market within 24 months from the date of the transport document (bill of lading). Service export receipts must be channeled within 6 months from the invoice accrual date. There is no statutory partial conversion ratio; the entire amount is subject to the channeling obligation, although the exporter may temporarily hold the USD in a foreign-currency account at the IMC and sell to the IMC at the prevailing market rate (Tasa Representativa del Mercado, TRM) at any time within the applicable term. Failure to channel exposes the exporter to exchange-control fines (multas cambiarias) up to 200% of the unchanneled amount and may jeopardize the VAT zero-rating of the export and the deductibility of related costs.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational current account in COP and USD / Capital escrow account (cuenta de garantia) usable for standby LC-backed trade financing
Operational multi-currency account (COP/USD) / Capital escrow account configurable for pre-export financing structures
Operational COP/USD account / Escrow collateral module available under corporate cash management platform
Operational COP/USD accounts / Escrow and pledge accounts supported for cross-border credit lines
Operational current account / Capital escrow account limited to internal collateralization of FX forward lines
Operational current account / Escrow account available on a case-by-case approval basis

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW for primary treasury and FX operations; MEDIUM as a supplementary channel for non-FX local disbursements (payroll, petty cash, local supplier payments). Offshore EMIs (Airwallex, Wise, Revolut Business, Currencycloud, Payoneer) do not hold an IMC license from the SFC and therefore cannot legally execute the mandatory channeling of the SAS export proceeds, receive FDI capital, or settle import payments as foreign-exchange transactions. Routing export or capital flows through an offshore EMI creates unreported operaciones cambiarias, exposes the SAS to exchange-control penalties, and weakens the audit trail required by the DIAN and the SFC. Locally authorized SEDPE electronic wallets (Nequi, Daviplata, Movii, Lulo Bank) are lawful for domestic COP payments only and cannot replace an IMC for any FX-related settlement.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A physical KYC/CDD interview at the branch is required for at least one Colombian-resident authorized representative, in practice the legal representative (representante legal) of the SAS, before the corporate operating or FX account is activated. For foreign shareholders and directors, physical presence in Colombia is not mandatory: the Colombian legal representative or a grantee under an apostilled power of attorney may appear in person, while the bank will verify the foreign UBOs by video call and will require apostilled, certified copies of passports and of the shareholder constitutional documents. Fully remote opening of corporate operating or FX-related accounts is not permitted by the SFC; only SEDPE wallet opening is a fully remote process; therefore the blueprint must budget for a physical visit by the appointed local signatory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Onboarding request by a newly incorporated SAS controlled by a non-resident shareholder domiciled in a low-tax jurisdiction with no prior trading history.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled certificate of incorporation and good standing of the foreign shareholder; notarized board resolution approving the account opening; DIAN UBO registry certificate (Resolution 164 of 2021) showing the final beneficiaries; sworn declaration of lawful origin of capital; audited financial statements or bank reference letter of the shareholder; three-year cash-flow and business plan for the dialysis consumables plant.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity USD receipts from distributor networks located in jurisdictions such as Panama, the United Arab Emirates, or Hong Kong, with mismatches between e-invoices and payment references.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed international supply and distribution agreements with Incoterms; commercial invoices with matching packing lists; bills of lading and freight forwarder certificates; INVIMA sanitary registration of the hemofilter products and ISO 13485 quality certification; completed customer due-diligence questionnaires; export customs declarations and the corresponding Declaración de Cambio por Exportaciones evidencing same-bank channeling of each collection.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound settlement from an intermediate third-country bank whose name differs from the named buyer, creating a structuring red flag for the Colombian AML system (SAGRILAFT).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Copy of the documentary letter of credit (MT700/MT710) issued by the buyer's bank; bill of lading consigned to the SAS; proof of the SWIFT chain (MT202 or MT202COV) linking the intermediate bank to the LC proceeds; a completed bank questionnaire explaining the payment routing; contemporaneous email correspondence with the buyer evidencing the commercial reason for the intermediate institution.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between large USD export inflows and low local COP operating expenditures, indicating potential pass-through or trade-based money laundering.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited financial statements of the SAS; annual corporate income tax return (Formulario 110) and VAT returns; transfer pricing Local File demonstrating arm's-length margins on intra-group purchases of polyethersulfone resin and potting materials; invoices from contract manufacturers; payroll reports; month-end bank reconciliations of all FX conversions with the applicable TRM.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound equity contributions to the Colombian SAS must be wired by SWIFT MT103 (TT) in USD or EUR to the SAS account at an IMC, using purpose code 21 for direct investment and the payment reference 'Aporte de capital social SAS'. The relationship manager must receive the notarial minutes of the shareholders meeting authorizing the capital increase, the updated certificate of existence and legal representation of the SAS, and the bank reference of the remitting shareholder. The IMC will file the Declaración de Cambio por Inversión Internacional (Formulario No. 2) and will convert the foreign currency into COP at the prevailing TRM unless a matched forward is previously booked. Post-settlement compliance: register the capital increase in the SAS shareholder registry and update the DIAN UBO filing; retain the stamped exchange declaration as the legal basis for future repatriation of capital and dividends.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For import settlements of polyethersulfone resin, polyurethane potting compounds, and packaging materials, the recommended rails are: (i) irrevocable documentary letters of credit (SWIFT MT700, UCP600) issued by the Colombian IMC for major suppliers; (ii) direct SWIFT MT103 customer transfers for routine payments; (iii) 30-to-90-day open account funded from export collections. All import payments must be declared in the Declaración de Cambio por Importaciones (Formulario No. 1) and supported by the customs import declaration and the Declaración Andina del Valor. For export collections, acceptable instruments are sight LCs confirmed by the buyer's bank or documentary collections (MT400 series), with all proceeds channeled back into the IMC account within the 24-month statutory term. The corporately mandated rails are therefore Swift_LC and TT_Wire, as stated in the target payment rails metadata.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: COP/USD deliverable forward contracts (Forwards de Tasa de Cambio) executed with an SFC-authorized IMC, requiring an underlying commercial exposure such as the dialysis hemofilter export receivable or the import payable.

COP/USD non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for maturities where physical delivery in USD is not desired; settlement is made in COP against the TRM, with the underlying export or import cash flow evidenced at inception.
Cross-currency swaps (CCS) between COP and USD used to hedge the interest and principal of a USD-denominated shareholder loan financing the dialysis production line.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil (Annual Commercial Registry Renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (Chamber of Commerce of the registered domicile)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal penalty from COP 135,000 to COP 675,000; continued non-renewal triggers cancellation of the commercial registration and administrative strike-off of the SAS.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración de Renta y Complementarios (Annual Corporate Income Tax Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual calendar published by DIAN Resolution; deadline determined by the last two digits of the NIT, generally falling between August and October of the following tax year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of 5% of the tax due per month of delay, capped at 100%; default interest accrues monthly; non-filing enables official assessment, asset attachment, and potential criminal exposure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Información Exógena Anual (Annual Third-Party and Tax Information Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by the date fixed in the applicable DIAN Resolution, typically early August following the fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to 10,000 UVT (approximately USD 110,000) for extemporaneous, erroneous, or omitted information; reduced penalties apply for voluntary late filing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Estados Financieros aprobados y acta de asamblea (Approved Financial Statements and Shareholders' Meeting Minutes)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social and commercial registry archives
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders must approve annual financial statements within three months of fiscal year-end; filed with the Chamber of Commerce immediately after approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines under Commercial Code Article 94 for non-registration of accounts; company may lose legal standing and risk registration cancellation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Reporte Anual de Beneficiario Final (Annual UBO Confirmation via RUT)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual update and confirmation of ultimate beneficial owner information on the Registro Único Tributario (RUT), per the anniversary schedule set by DIAN Resolution
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monetary fines of up to 16,000 UVT (approximately USD 180,000) for failure to report or for updating UBO data inaccurately; administrative suspensions possible.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración Anual de Industria y Comercio (Municipal ICA Tax Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Secretaría de Hacienda del municipio donde se desarrollan las actividades industriales (municipal treasury)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Generally due in April of the following tax year on gross income derived from manufacturing operations; municipality-specific calendar applies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly default interest of 1.5% on outstanding tax; late-filing fines from 5% to 10% of the tax assessed; enforced collection and asset seizure on persistent default.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Colombian SAS must appoint a Revisor Fiscal when total assets exceed 5,000 times the statutory monthly minimum wage (~USD 1.7 million) or when the annual workforce exceeds 200 employees; medical device manufacturers should nonetheless retain an independent auditor to support INVIMA quality-system certifications and lender covenants.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Colombia under Law 1314 of 2009 and Decree 2420 of 2015; a non-listed manufacturing SAS typically applies IFRS for SMEs (Grupo 2), with full IFRS mandatory only for public-interest entities or issuers of securities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SAS must update and confirm its ultimate beneficial owner information annually through the RUT filing with DIAN; any transfer of shares must be entered in the Shareholders' Register within 30 days of execution, and the UBO status must be re-certified in the subsequent annual RUT confirmation window.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Libro de Actas de Asamblea (Minute Book of Shareholders' Meetings)
Libro de Registro de Beneficiarios Finales (UBO Register)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600–1,500 per annum for a compliant registered office and local corporate agent in Bogotá or Medellín
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 4,000–12,000 per annum for a certified financial statement audit of a mid-sized dialysis consumables manufacturer, depending on asset complexity and inventory valuation
